text:
Maya Patel: quick sync — BrightHealth requested eval-triggered alerts + Optimize advisor recommendations (batching, cache TTL, quant). they want a short pilot in July.
Samir Khan: two tracks: alerts (webhook + rules) and advisor (telemetry + recs). agree to split.
Jen Lee: ship alerts MVP first (simple threshold + webhook + per-tenant toggle).
Ravi Kumar: note: KV TTL heuristic = if duplicate_rate>0.2 and p99<150ms recommend TTL up to 600s; quant gating = 100-shot eval, require quality_drop < 0.8% and latency_gain > 15% to recommend int8.
Alex Gomez: field ask — low FP (<5%), clear rationale in recs, CSV export, RBAC toggle. BrightHealth will provide a labeled set (2k).
Maya Patel: actions: Samir -> acceptance matrix Wed EOD; Jen -> alert payload + UX Fri; Ravi -> heuristics Tue. I'll raise GPU budget and schedule kickoff.
Samir Khan: proposed acceptance SLOs: alert precision >95% on labeled set, alert latency <=2s, webhook retries 3.
Jen Lee: alerts should include "why" + suggested next action.
Maya Patel: timeline: slice A (alerts MVP) = 6 weeks; slice B (advisor + UI) = follow-on 6-8 weeks. gating: customer sign-off on A to proceed.
